title: oc-arkive OpenCode v2 Plugin Options
description: The options object of the oc-arkive entry in an OpenCode v2 `plugins` list. OpenCode v1 ignores it; v1 configuration stays in ~/.config/opencode/agent_hive.json.

readTransport.description: How agents reach hive_repositories_status, hive_git_snapshot and hive_task_trace_content. `codemode` runs them inside Code Mode and needs the `execute` tool; `direct` registers them as direct tool calls, for configurations that deny `execute`. Every other Hive tool is a direct call in both modes.

server.description: The running OpenCode v2 server, for the session reads the in-process plugin API does not offer. Each binding is verified against this activation's own identity before use. Without it those reads report that they are not configured.

url.description: Server base URL, for example http://127.0.0.1:4096. Must be http or https, without credentials, query or fragment.

username.description: Basic-auth user name the server expects.

passwordEnv.description: Name of the environment variable, in the server process, that holds the server password (for example OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD). The password itself is never written in configuration.
